discription: Warm, evolving pad sound created by two detuned pulse oscillators passed through a resonant low-pass filter.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, pan=0, attack=0.8, decay=0.5, sustain=0.7, release=3.0, detuneAmount=0.002, pulseWidth=0.5, filterCutoff=3000, filterRes=0.2; var sig, env; env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(attack, decay, sustain, release, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); var osc1 = Pulse.ar(freq, width: pulseWidth); var osc2 = Pulse.ar(freq * (1 + detuneAmount), width: pulseWidth); sig = (osc1 + osc2) * 0.5; sig = RLPF.ar(sig, filterCutoff, filterRes); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, Pan2.ar(sig, pan));}
